local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

-- НАСТРОЙКИ
local FOV_RADIUS = 150
local MIN_FOV = 50
local MAX_FOV = 400

local AimLockEnabled = false
local ESPEnabled = false
local WallCheckEnabled = true
local FOVEnabled = true

local Highlights = {}

-- GUI
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "AimLockGUI"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ScreenGui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- ПАНЕЛЬ
local Panel = Instance.new("Frame")
Panel.Parent = ScreenGui
Panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 260)
Panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -100, 0.7, 0)
Panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 45)
Panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
Panel.Active = true

local PanelCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
PanelCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
PanelCorner.Parent = Panel

-- ФУНКЦИЯ СОЗДАНИЯ КНОПОК
local function CreateButton(text, position, size)
	local Button = Instance.new("TextButton")
	Button.Parent = Panel
	Button.Size = size
	Button.Position = position
	Button.Text = text
	Button.TextScaled = true
	Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
	Button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	Button.BorderSizePixel = 0

	local Corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
	Corner.Parent = Button

	return Button
end

-- AIMLOCK
local AimButton = CreateButton(
	"AimLock: HOLD RMB",
	UDim2.fromOffset(5, 5),
	UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 40)
)

-- ESP
local ESPButton = CreateButton(
	"ESP: OFF",
	UDim2.fromOffset(5, 50),
	UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 40)
)

-- WALL CHECK
local WallButton = CreateButton(
	"WallCheck: ON",
	UDim2.fromOffset(5, 95),
	UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 40)
)

WallButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 150, 60)

-- FOV
local FOVButton = CreateButton(
	"FOV: ON",
	UDim2.fromOffset(5, 140),
	UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 40)
)

FOVButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 150, 60)

-- КНОПКА ЗАКРЫТИЯ
local CloseButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
CloseButton.Parent = Panel
CloseButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28)
CloseButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -33, 0, 5)
CloseButton.Text = "X"
CloseButton.TextScaled = true
CloseButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 50, 50)
CloseButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
CloseButton.BorderSizePixel = 0

local CloseCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
CloseCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
CloseCorner.Parent = CloseButton

-- FOV SLIDER
local SliderBackground = Instance.new("Frame")
SliderBackground.Parent = Panel
SliderBackground.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 6)
SliderBackground.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 195)
SliderBackground.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100)
SliderBackground.BorderSizePixel = 0

local SliderCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
SliderCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
SliderCorner.Parent = SliderBackground

local SliderButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
SliderButton.Parent = SliderBackground
SliderButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16)
SliderButton.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)

local StartPercent =
	(FOV_RADIUS - MIN_FOV) / (MAX_FOV - MIN_FOV)

SliderButton.Position = UDim2.new(StartPercent, 0, 0.5, 0)
SliderButton.Text = ""
SliderButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
SliderButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
SliderButton.AutoButtonColor = false

local SliderButtonCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
SliderButtonCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
SliderButtonCorner.Parent = SliderButton

-- ТЕКСТ FOV
local FOVLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
FOVLabel.Parent = Panel
FOVLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 25)
FOVLabel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 205)
FOVLabel.Text = "FOV: " .. FOV_RADIUS
FOVLabel.TextScaled = true
FOVLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
FOVLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

-- ПЕРЕТАСКИВАНИЕ ПАНЕЛИ
local dragging = false
local dragStart
local startPos

Panel.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = Panel.Position
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if dragging and (
		input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
	) then

		local delta = input.Position - dragStart

		Panel.Position = UDim2.new(
			startPos.X.Scale,
			startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
			startPos.Y.Scale,
			startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
		)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = false
	end
end)

-- ЗАКРЫТИЕ ПАНЕЛИ
CloseButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	Panel.Visible = false
end)

-- RIGHT SHIFT ОТКРЫТЬ / ЗАКРЫТЬ
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
	if processed then return end

	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
		Panel.Visible = not Panel.Visible
	end
end)

-- FOV КРУГ
local FOVCircle = Instance.new("Frame")
FOVCircle.Parent = ScreenGui
FOVCircle.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
FOVCircle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
FOVCircle.BorderSizePixel = 0

local CircleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
CircleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
CircleCorner.Parent = FOVCircle

local CircleStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
CircleStroke.Parent = FOVCircle
CircleStroke.Thickness = 2
CircleStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

local function UpdateFOV()
	FOVCircle.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(
		FOV_RADIUS * 2,
		FOV_RADIUS * 2
	)

	FOVLabel.Text = "FOV: " .. math.floor(FOV_RADIUS)
end

UpdateFOV()

-- SLIDER
local sliderDragging = false

local function SetSliderFromX(x)
	local left = SliderBackground.AbsolutePosition.X
	local width = SliderBackground.AbsoluteSize.X

	local percent = math.clamp(
		(x - left) / width,
		0,
		1
	)

	FOV_RADIUS =
		MIN_FOV + (MAX_FOV - MIN_FOV) * percent

	SliderButton.Position =
		UDim2.new(percent, 0, 0.5, 0)

	UpdateFOV()
end

SliderButton.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
	sliderDragging = true
end)

SliderBackground.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		sliderDragging = true
		SetSliderFromX(input.Position.X)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if sliderDragging and (
		input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
	) then

		SetSliderFromX(input.Position.X)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		sliderDragging = false
	end
end)

-- AIMLOCK: РАБОТАЕТ ПОКА ЗАЖАТА ПКМ
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
	if processed then return end

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
		AimLockEnabled = true
		AimButton.Text = "AimLock: ON"
		AimButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 150, 60)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
		AimLockEnabled = false
		AimButton.Text = "AimLock: HOLD RMB"
		AimButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
	end
end)

-- ПРОВЕРКА ВИДНОСТИ
local function IsVisible(Character, Head)
	local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position
	local direction = Head.Position - origin

	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
		LocalPlayer.Character
	}

	local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, params)

	if result then
		return result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(Character)
	end

	return false
end

-- ПОИСК ЦЕЛИ
local function GetClosestHead()
	local closestHead = nil
	local shortestDistance = math.huge

	local viewport = Camera.ViewportSize

	-- Такой же центр, как у круга
	local screenCenter = Vector2.new(
		viewport.X / 2,
		viewport.Y / 2 - 35
	)

	for _, Player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if Player ~= LocalPlayer and Player.Character then

			local Character = Player.Character
			local Head = Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
			local Humanoid =
				Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

			if Head and Humanoid and Humanoid.Health > 0 then
				local position, onScreen =
					Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(Head.Position)

				if onScreen then
					local screenPosition =
						Vector2.new(position.X, position.Y)

					local distance =
						(screenPosition - screenCenter).Magnitude

					local insideFOV = true

					if FOVEnabled then
						insideFOV = distance <= FOV_RADIUS
					end

					if insideFOV then
						local canAim = true

						if WallCheckEnabled then
							canAim = IsVisible(Character, Head)
						end

						if canAim and distance < shortestDistance then
							shortestDistance = distance
							closestHead = Head
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return closestHead
end

-- ESP
local function AddESP(Player)
	if Player == LocalPlayer then return end
	if not ESPEnabled then return end
	if not Player.Character then return end

	if Highlights[Player] then
		Highlights[Player]:Destroy()

			local localMoveDirection = camera.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(moveDirection)

local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")

local function Notify(title, text, duration)
    duration = duration or 4

    StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
        Title = title,
        Text = text,
        Duration = duration
    })

    task.spawn(function()
        local notificationGui = CoreGui:FindFirstChild("RobloxGui") 
            and CoreGui.RobloxGui:FindFirstChild("NotificationFrame")

        if not notificationGui then
            for _, v in pairs(CoreGui:GetDescendants()) do
                if v.Name == "NotificationFrame" or v.Name == "Notification" then
                    notificationGui = v
                    break
                end
            end
        end

        if notificationGui then
            notificationGui.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
            notificationGui.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 80)
        end
    end)
end

local function getExecutorName()
    if identifyexecutor then
        local name, version = identifyexecutor()
        return name or "Unknown", version
    elseif getexecutorname then
        return getexecutorname(), nil
    end
    return "Unknown", nil
end

local function isSupported()
    local hasHttp = typeof(game.HttpGet) == "function"
    local hasLoadstring = typeof(loadstring) == "function"
    local hasRequest = typeof(request) == "function" or (syn and typeof(syn.request) == "function")
    return hasHttp and hasLoadstring and hasRequest
end

local execName = getExecutorName()

if not isSupported() then
    Notify("CFrameFly", "Executor not supported!\nDetected: " .. execName, 5)
    return
end

Notify("CFrameFly", "Supported: " .. execName .. "\nLoading script...", 3)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

if playerGui:FindFirstChild("FlyUI") then
	playerGui.FlyUI:Destroy()
end

local speeds = {55, 95, 145}
local stage = 0
local flying = false
local flyConn
local bv, bg
local ikList = {}
local poseParts = {}
local windBits = {}
local lookPart, lookAtt, lookIK
local windSound
local windLevel = 0
local windShowing = false

local function getParts()
	local char = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	return char, char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart"), char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
end

local function resetNeck(char)
	local upper = char and char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
	local neck = upper and upper:FindFirstChild("Neck")
	local waist = upper and upper:FindFirstChild("Waist")
	if neck then neck.Transform = CFrame.identity end
	if waist then waist.Transform = CFrame.identity end
end

local function clearLook()
	if lookIK then lookIK:Destroy() lookIK = nil end
	if lookPart then lookPart:Destroy() lookPart = nil end
	lookAtt = nil
end

local function clearWind()
	for _, obj in ipairs(windBits) do
		if obj then obj:Destroy() end
	end
	windBits = {}
	if windSound then
		windSound:Stop()
		windSound:Destroy()
		windSound = nil
	end
	windShowing = false
end

local function clearPose()
	for _, ik in ipairs(ikList) do
		if ik then ik:Destroy() end
	end
	ikList = {}
	for _, part in ipairs(poseParts) do
		if part then part:Destroy() end
	end
	poseParts = {}
	clearLook()
	resetNeck(player.Character)
end

local function makeTarget(parent, offset)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = "InvisibleFlyTarget"
	part.Size = Vector3.new(0.15, 0.15, 0.15)
	part.Transparency = 1
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.Anchored = false
	part.Massless = true
	part.Parent = parent
	local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
	weld.Part0 = parent
	weld.Part1 = part
	weld.C0 = CFrame.new(offset)
	weld.Parent = part
	local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Parent = part
	table.insert(poseParts, part)
	return attachment
end

local function addIK(hum, endPart, rootPart, target, pole)
	if not endPart or not rootPart or not target then return end
	local ik = Instance.new("IKControl")
	ik.Type = Enum.IKControlType.Position
	ik.EndEffector = endPart
	ik.ChainRoot = rootPart
	ik.Target = target
	if pole then ik.Pole = pole end
	ik.Weight = 1
	ik.SmoothTime = 0.05
	ik.Parent = hum
	table.insert(ikList, ik)
end

local function startLookUp(char, hum)
	clearLook()
	local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
	if not head then return end
	lookPart = Instance.new("Part")
	lookPart.Name = "HeadLookTarget"
	lookPart.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
	lookPart.Transparency = 1
	lookPart.Anchored = true
	lookPart.CanCollide = false
	lookPart.CanQuery = false
	lookPart.Parent = workspace
	lookAtt = Instance.new("Attachment")
	lookAtt.Parent = lookPart
	lookIK = Instance.new("IKControl")
	lookIK.Type = Enum.IKControlType.LookAt
	lookIK.EndEffector = head
	lookIK.ChainRoot = head
	lookIK.Target = lookAtt
	lookIK.Weight = 1
	lookIK.SmoothTime = 0.05
	lookIK.Parent = hum
end

local function lockTorso(char)
	local upper = char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
	local lower = char:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso")
	local waist = upper and upper:FindFirstChild("Waist")
	local root = lower and lower:FindFirstChild("Root")
	if waist then waist.Transform = CFrame.identity end
	if root then root.Transform = CFrame.identity end
end

local function applyHoverPose(char, hum)
	clearPose()
	local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then return end
	addIK(hum, char:FindFirstChild("LeftHand"), char:FindFirstChild("LeftUpperArm"), makeTarget(hrp, Vector3.new(0.35, 0.55, -0.55)))
	addIK(hum, char:FindFirstChild("RightHand"), char:FindFirstChild("RightUpperArm"), makeTarget(hrp, Vector3.new(-0.35, 0.35, -0.55)))
	addIK(hum, char:FindFirstChild("LeftFoot"), char:FindFirstChild("LeftUpperLeg"), makeTarget(hrp, Vector3.new(-0.55, -2.35, 0.45)))
	addIK(hum, char:FindFirstChild("RightFoot"), char:FindFirstChild("RightUpperLeg"), makeTarget(hrp, Vector3.new(0.55, -2.35, 0.45)))
end

local function applyFlightPose(char, hum)
	clearPose()
	local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then return end
	local leftHand = makeTarget(hrp, Vector3.new(-1.15, 2.8, 0.05))
	local rightHand = makeTarget(hrp, Vector3.new(1.15, 2.8, 0.05))
	local leftFoot = makeTarget(hrp, Vector3.new(-0.28, -2.85, 0.05))
	local rightFoot = makeTarget(hrp, Vector3.new(0.28, -2.85, 0.05))
	local leftPole = makeTarget(hrp, Vector3.new(-0.28, -1.2, 0.35))
	local rightPole = makeTarget(hrp, Vector3.new(0.28, -1.2, 0.35))
	addIK(hum, char:FindFirstChild("LeftHand"), char:FindFirstChild("LeftUpperArm"), leftHand)
	addIK(hum, char:FindFirstChild("RightHand"), char:FindFirstChild("RightUpperArm"), rightHand)
	addIK(hum, char:FindFirstChild("LeftFoot"), char:FindFirstChild("LeftUpperLeg"), leftFoot, leftPole)
	addIK(hum, char:FindFirstChild("RightFoot"), char:FindFirstChild("RightUpperLeg"), rightFoot, rightPole)
	startLookUp(char, hum)
end

local function addWindLine(hrp, startOffset, length, thickness)
	local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
	a0.Position = startOffset
	a0.Parent = hrp

	local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
	a1.Position = startOffset + Vector3.new(0, -length, 0)
	a1.Parent = hrp

	local beam = Instance.new("Beam")
	beam.Attachment0 = a0
	beam.Attachment1 = a1
	beam.Width0 = thickness
	beam.Width1 = 0.02
	beam.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(190, 195, 205))
	beam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.2),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)
	})
	beam.FaceCamera = true
	beam.LightEmission = 0.25
	beam.Parent = hrp

	table.insert(windBits, a0)
	table.insert(windBits, a1)
	table.insert(windBits, beam)
end

local function setWind(hrp, level)
	clearWind()
	windLevel = level
	if level <= 0 or not hrp then return end

	local lines = {
		{Vector3.new(-0.9, 0.2, 0.15), 3.4, 0.07},
		{Vector3.new(0.9, 0.2, 0.15), 3.6, 0.07},
		{Vector3.new(-1.4, -0.4, 0.1), 3.2, 0.06},
		{Vector3.new(1.4, -0.4, 0.1), 3.2, 0.06},
		{Vector3.new(0, -0.8, 0.2), 3.8, 0.06},
		{Vector3.new(-0.4, 0.8, 0.05), 2.8, 0.05},
		{Vector3.new(0.4, 0.8, 0.05), 2.8, 0.05},
	}
	if level == 2 then
		table.insert(lines, {Vector3.new(-1.8, 0.6, 0.1), 4.8, 0.06})
		table.insert(lines, {Vector3.new(1.8, 0.6, 0.1), 4.8, 0.06})
		table.insert(lines, {Vector3.new(-2.2, -0.2, 0.05), 5.2, 0.05})
		table.insert(lines, {Vector3.new(2.2, -0.2, 0.05), 5.2, 0.05})
		table.insert(lines, {Vector3.new(0, 1.4, 0.05), 4.4, 0.05})
		table.insert(lines, {Vector3.new(-0.7, -1.6, 0.15), 4.6, 0.05})
		table.insert(lines, {Vector3.new(0.7, -1.6, 0.15), 4.6, 0.05})
		table.insert(lines, {Vector3.new(-1.2, 1.3, 0.08), 4.2, 0.05})
		table.insert(lines, {Vector3.new(1.2, 1.3, 0.08), 4.2, 0.05})
		table.insert(lines, {Vector3.new(0, -2.1, 0.12), 5.0, 0.05})
	end

	for _, info in ipairs(lines) do
		addWindLine(hrp, info[1], info[2], info[3])
	end

	windSound = Instance.new("Sound")
	if level == 1 then
		windSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://463114572"
		windSound.Volume = 1
		windSound.PlaybackSpeed = 1
	else
		windSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://9120769456"
		windSound.Volume = 1.6
		windSound.PlaybackSpeed = 1
	end
	windSound.Looped = true
	windSound.Parent = hrp
	windSound:Play()
	table.insert(windBits, windSound)
	windShowing = true
end

local function footRing(hrp)
	local ring = Instance.new("Part")
	ring.Name = "BoostRing"
	ring.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	ring.Size = Vector3.new(0.12, 2, 2)
	ring.Anchored = true
	ring.CanCollide = false
	ring.CanQuery = false
	ring.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	ring.Color = Color3.fromRGB(190, 198, 210)
	ring.Transparency = 0.25
	ring.CFrame = CFrame.new(hrp.Position - Vector3.new(0, 2.6, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
	ring.Parent = workspace

	local start = tick()
	local conn
	conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local t = (tick() - start) / 0.35
		if t >= 1 or not ring.Parent then
			conn:Disconnect()
			if ring then ring:Destroy() end
			return
		end
		local s = 2 + t * 16
		ring.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, s, s)
		ring.Transparency = 0.25 + t * 0.75
	end)
	Debris:AddItem(ring, 0.4)
end

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "FlyUI"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.Parent = playerGui

local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
btn.Size = UDim2.new(0.28, 0, 0.12, 0)
btn.Position = UDim2.new(0.68, 0, 0.78, 0)
btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 140, 220)
btn.Text = "VOAR"
btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
btn.TextScaled = true
btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
btn.Parent = gui
Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.2, 0)

local function stopFly()
	flying = false
	stage = 0
	windLevel = 0
	btn.Text = "VOAR"
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 140, 220)
	if flyConn then flyConn:Disconnect() flyConn = nil end
	if bv then bv:Destroy() bv = nil end
	if bg then bg:Destroy() bg = nil end
	clearPose()
	clearWind()
	local char = player.Character
	if char then
		local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum then
			hum.PlatformStand = false
			hum.AutoRotate = true
		end
	end
end

local function startFly()
	flying = true
	stage = 1
	btn.Text = "BOOST 1"
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 120, 210)

	local char, hrp, hum = getParts()
	hum.PlatformStand = true
	hum.AutoRotate = false

	bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
	bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e6, 1e6, 1e6)
	bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
	bv.Parent = hrp

	bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
	bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e6, 1e6, 1e6)
	bg.P = 20000
	bg.D = 1500
	bg.Parent = hrp

	local hovering = false
	local flightPose = false

	flyConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if not hrp.Parent then
			stopFly()
			return
		end

		local camCF = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame
		local move = hum.MoveDirection
		local moving = move.Magnitude > 0.05
		local speed = speeds[stage] or 55

		if moving then
			if windLevel > 0 and not windShowing then
				setWind(hrp, windLevel)
			end
			lockTorso(char)
			local flatLook = Vector3.new(camCF.LookVector.X, 0, camCF.LookVector.Z)
			local flatRight = Vector3.new(camCF.RightVector.X, 0, camCF.RightVector.Z)
			if flatLook.Magnitude > 0.01 then flatLook = flatLook.Unit end
			if flatRight.Magnitude > 0.01 then flatRight = flatRight.Unit end

			local flyDir = (camCF.LookVector * move:Dot(flatLook)) + (camCF.RightVector * move:Dot(flatRight))
			if flyDir.Magnitude > 0.01 then
				flyDir = flyDir.Unit
				bv.Velocity = flyDir * speed
				bg.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(hrp.Position, hrp.Position + flyDir) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-75), 0, 0)
				if lookPart then
					lookPart.Position = hrp.Position + flyDir * 4 + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
				end
			end

			if hovering then
				clearPose()
				hovering = false
			end
			if not flightPose then
				applyFlightPose(char, hum)
				flightPose = true
			end
		else
			bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
			bg.CFrame = camCF
			if windShowing then
				local saved = windLevel
				clearWind()
				windLevel = saved
			end
			if flightPose then
				clearPose()
				flightPose = false
			end
			if not hovering then
				applyHoverPose(char, hum)
				hovering = true
			end
		end
	end)
end

btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	if stage == 0 then

		btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 90, 220)

		footRing(hrp)
	else

	end
end)

scripts.script:
-- [[ CONFIGURATION ]]
local TOGGLE_KEY        = Enum.KeyCode.V
local PANIC_KEY         = Enum.KeyCode.End
local AUTO_OFF_MINUTES  = 10

-- [[ CORE SERVICES ]]
local Players          = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService  = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService       = game:GetService("RunService")
local CoreGui          = game:GetService("CoreGui")

local player    = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 5)
local uniqueTag = "TrueRightClickUnlocker_v105"
local bindName  = "MouseUnlockerPriorityLoop_v105"

-- [[ 1. MEMORY & TELEPORT CLEANUP ]]
local function globalCleanup()
    pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(bindName) end)
    for _, obj in pairs(CoreGui:GetChildren()) do
        if obj:GetAttribute(uniqueTag) or obj.Name == "InternalMouseControlMax" then 
            pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end) 
        end
    end
    if playerGui then
        for _, obj in pairs(playerGui:GetChildren()) do
            if obj:GetAttribute(uniqueTag) or obj.Name == "InternalMouseControlMax" then 
                pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end) 
            end
        end
    end
end
globalCleanup() 

-- [[ 2. UI CONTAINER ]]
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "InternalMouseControlMax"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
screenGui:SetAttribute(uniqueTag, true)

local parentSuccess = pcall(function() screenGui.Parent = CoreGui end)
if not parentSuccess and playerGui then screenGui.Parent = playerGui end

local toggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
toggleBtn.Name = "MaxOverride"
toggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
toggleBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
toggleBtn.Text = ""
toggleBtn.Modal = false 
toggleBtn.Parent = screenGui

-- [[ 3. SMART CAMERA & SHIFT-LOCK PROFILER ]]
local function isFirstPerson()
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return false end
    
    if player.CameraMode == Enum.CameraMode.LockFirstPerson then return true end
    
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return false end

    local trackingPart = char:FindFirstChild("Head") 
        or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") 
        or char.PrimaryPart
        
    if trackingPart then
        local distance = (cam.CFrame.Position - trackingPart.Position).Magnitude
        return distance <= 2.2
    end

    return false
end

-- [[ 4. PRIORITY RENDER LOOP ]]
local rightMouseDown = false
local startTime = os.time()

local function priorityFrameUpdate()
    if (os.time() - startTime) >= (AUTO_OFF_MINUTES * 60) then
        toggleBtn.Modal = false
        pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(bindName) end)
        UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
        return
    end

    if toggleBtn.Modal and not isFirstPerson() then
        toggleBtn.Modal = false
        pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(bindName) end)
        UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
        return
    end

    if toggleBtn.Modal then
        if rightMouseDown then
            UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
        else
            UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
        end
    end
end

-- [[ 5. HARDENED EVENT LISTENERS ]]
local connections = {}

local function terminateSystem()
    toggleBtn.Modal = false
    globalCleanup()
    for _, conn in pairs(connections) do
        if conn then conn:Disconnect() end
    end
    table.clear(connections)
    UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
end

table.insert(connections, UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if input.KeyCode == TOGGLE_KEY then
        if not isFirstPerson() then return end
        
        toggleBtn.Modal = not toggleBtn.Modal
        if toggleBtn.Modal then
            UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
            startTime = os.time() 
            RunService:BindToRenderStep(bindName, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, priorityFrameUpdate)
        else
            pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(bindName) end)
            UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
        end
    elseif input.KeyCode == PANIC_KEY then
        terminateSystem()
    end
    
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
        rightMouseDown = true
    end
end))

table.insert(connections, UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
        rightMouseDown = false
    end
end))

table.insert(connections, UserInputService.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(function()
    rightMouseDown = false
end))
